command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-code.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-code stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R1's Fix names the new files `locations_clock_change_note_changes_unit.feature` / `steps/locations_clock_change_note_changes_unit.steps.ts`, against `.claude/rules/bdd-unit.md`: "The `_unit` suffix is added only when a paired `_e2e` file exists for the same aspect". No `_e2e` file exists for a 'changes' aspect, so the Fix should name them `locations_clock_change_note_changes.feature` / `locations_clock_change_note_changes.steps.ts`, as the change's own `locations_clock_change_note_placement.feature` split does.

Tasks line 7.1 is marked ✅ although the review says `src/model/dayPeriodWindows.ts`, one of the files task 7.1 needs at >=95%, 'could not finish… (70/86 tested)' and has no measured score. M3 is marked ⚠️ for the same gap. 7.1 should be ⚠️ to match, or the changed lines (`findOffsetTransitions`, lines 44-65) should be measured with a line-range `--mutate` so the evidence can be confirmed.
